nodes.text: Yes! We did it! The wedding is completely ruined!

nodes.text: I thought you were good with horses...

nodes.text: What is that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm just saying I'm surprised I had to do most of the work feeding them back there.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Is you doing all the manual labor really so hard to believe?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That was pretty fun actually!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It looked like it...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You really think Margot will break up with Tad now?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There's no more wedding fog! She'll have to see him for what he truly is!
She grabs Owen by the hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Come on! We've gotta get back before anyone discovers what happened!
A few minutes later, in the main hall of the estate, Paige and Owen have successfully blended back in with the guests, when--

nodes.speaker: Voice
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [i]AHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHHH![/i]

nodes.text: The guests pour out of the hall and outside to the wedding area! Margot is already there, distraught!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHH!` The wedding! It's ruined!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHH![/i][/color] The wedding! It's ruined!

nodes.text: Tad fights his way through the guests to the front and cries out when he sees the destruction.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: `No!` How did this happen?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color] How did this happen?

nodes.text: The horses are in view behind the wedding chaos, grazing on the grass. Owen's horse has a folding chair stuck to its hoof but doesn't seem to mind.

nodes.speaker: Horse
nodes.text: Frrbbt!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Grr! I'd ask who's responsible for this, but I think I already know!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You think someone we know did `this?` On purpose?
nodes.text_bbcode: You think someone we know did [color=#3b78e2][i]this?[/i][/color] On purpose?

nodes.text: Tad glares at Paige and Owen.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I know it, but I can't prove it.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Never mind that!
Paige steps forward...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, Mother. First your dress, and now this.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I know... I don't think I can marry you, Tad. Not today...
Tad's face turns a dark red color. For a second, it looks like he's going to explode. But then...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I... I understand, Margot.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You do?
He awkwardly takes Margot's hand.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Of course. But if you'll reconsider, I do have a contingency plan in place. A `second,` indoor wedding spot.
nodes.text_bbcode: Of course. But if you'll reconsider, I do have a contingency plan in place. A [color=#e23b3b][i]second,[/i][/color] indoor wedding spot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you serious?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Are you serious?!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I am. Will you still marry me today?
Margot nods, almost reluctantly, but nods just the same.
You are now playing as Owen...
As soon as Margot nods, Paige grabs Owen and pulls him aside.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I already know where your crazed head is going, but that's it, Paige. There's nothing more we can do!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There is still `one` thing.
nodes.text_bbcode: There is still [color=#3b78e2][i]one[/i][/color] thing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Really? 'Cause we destroyed the dress, and Margot had a backup dress!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We destroyed the wedding site, and Tad had a backup site!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It looks to me like they're set on getting married!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's why we have to get rid of something they don't have a backup for!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Like my mother's ring!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No. Way.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: We're not going to destroy it! We'll just hide it!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And what happens when your mother is crying her eyes out?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She'll break up with Tad, and her life will be better! My life will be better! Our relationship will be better!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And the ring?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She'll think she lost it. It'll turn up later. By then it won't matter!
Owen shakes his head disapprovingly.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine! I'll take it! All you'll have to do is stand guard.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not going to do that. It feels wrong. I'm not going to--
Margot comes running up!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige, dear, I need you! We have to prepare the banquet hall!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, I'll just be--

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: `Now,` Paige. This cannot wait!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Now,[/i][/color] Paige. This cannot wait!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But--

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Don't make me raise my voice in front of our guests!
It's obvious that Paige's mind is racing for an excuse, but she can't come up with one.
Margot pulls her away, and all Paige has time to do is look back at Owen and say...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Please... For us...
Soon, Owen is standing there, alone...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. I'm going to do this now, aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Margot

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And what quality is that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know, that thing that makes you say, 'I feel stuck, I need to get out! I need to get out now!'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But for some dumb reason, you stay! Much longer than you should!
Owen manages to unhook the dress and quickly slips out of the room.

nodes.speaker: Margot

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Finally...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, uh, good.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: You're young, Paige. The world is more complicated then you realize.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. I get it. Good talk.
Paige quickly stands up and leaves.
Later, Paige meets up with Owen in her room.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We got the dress!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, barely! What happened back there?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: The dress got stuck.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, but it only got stuck because you stopped and turned.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Don't tell me you suddenly got cold feet! Remember, we're doing this for my mother `and` for us! There's no time to be moral!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't tell me you suddenly got cold feet! Remember, we're doing this for my mother [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] for us! There's no time to be moral!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, yeah, that was exactly it... My moral code... Acting up.
Paige starts tearing at the bottom of the wedding dress.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Isn't this thing like a hundred thousand dollars?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yup.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's `two` whole vases you're destroying!
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]two[/i][/color] whole vases you're destroying!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You know, if you had more money, you wouldn't care so much about being moral all the time.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Oh no! My dress! What happened?!

nodes.text: One of the servants of the manor said they were doing some last minute alterations, and they had an accident with the sewing machine...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: An accident! My dress looks like it's been in a shark attack! Which worker was it?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I, uh, I fired her on the spot!
Margot sinks down onto the bed, holding her now tattered dress, and begins to cry.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, Mother... Are you still going to have the wedding?
For a moment, as Margot wipes tears from her eyes, it looks like the answer is no...
But then her back stiffens, her shoulders raise, and she takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Yes, I have to marry Tad. For this family.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But, the dress...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Tad was thoughtful enough. He bought me a backup.
Margot goes to her closet and slides a bunch of clothes aside, revealing a second wedding dress!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I... I think that I admire your resolve, Mother.
Later, Paige meets up with Owen...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, did it work?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No! She's got a backup dress! And the wedding is in just a few hours!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What do you want to do now?
Paige looks outside, at the chairs, and the flowers... And the altar.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I want to get `serious.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I want to get [color=#3b78e2][i]serious.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You are now playing as Owen...
Owen follows behind Paige as they head across the estate in the direction of the stables.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Stop running so... Angry!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I bet none of the other boyfriends have to do this kind of stuff!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Ben's probably making out with Emily. Kevin's playing videogames with Kimi. Hector's dancing at a college party with Amanda.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What am I about to do? I'm about to wade through horse manure so my girlfriend can destroy a wedding.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, 'cause I've never done `anything` unsavory for you...
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, 'cause I've never done [color=#3b78e2][i]anything[/i][/color] unsavory for you...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Point taken. I'll shut up now.

Inside are three horses, a gray one, a brown one, and the black one Owen rode for his polo match the day before.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Horse!

nodes.speaker: Horse
nodes.text: Frrrrrpt!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Does he always sound like that?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't judge.

A stablehand steps in, looking at the horses.

nodes.speaker: Stablehand
nodes.text: You critters are making an awful lotta noise...

nodes.speaker: Stablehand
nodes.text: Since I'm out here, might as well say howdy!

nodes.speaker: Stablehand
nodes.text: Hey there, Lazarus!

nodes.speaker: Lazarus
nodes.text: Neeeeigh!

nodes.speaker: Stablehand
nodes.text: Good morning to you, too!

nodes.speaker: Stablehand
nodes.text: Don't worry. I didn't forget you, Jasmine.

nodes.speaker: Jasmine

Finally, the black one...

nodes.speaker: Stablehand
nodes.text: And you know I'll always give you attention, Chizzlefuzz.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Chizzlefuzz?!

nodes.speaker: Horse
nodes.text: Snort!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If people called me that, I'd be upset too!
An alarm goes off on the stablehand's phone.

nodes.speaker: Stablehand
nodes.text: Gotta go! I think that wedding across the grass might be starting in an hour or so!
The stablehand leaves.

nodes.text: You're the horse expert... How do we do this?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm going to get some food... You coax them out of their stalls.

nodes.speaker: Owen

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Duh. Making horse sounds! But do it quietly!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Horse sounds... Right... Here we go...

nodes.text: Ha! Love! Talk to me when you're older.

nodes.text: If love was the only reason to get married, no one would ever get married!

nodes.speaker: Margot

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What are you doing with my dress?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Cleaning it!

nodes.text: No, ma'am! I would never!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Well, then, what?!

nodes.text: Yeah, Owen, what are you doing?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just, uh, I just wanted to... To... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: To try it on! You know, I'll never get a chance to be a bride, so...
Owen holds the dress up to his figure. Margot faints, falling to the floor!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `That` was your best answer?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]That[/i][/color] was your best answer?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you kind of put me in a corner! What do we do?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In a minute, she's going to come to, and she's going to remember what you said!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You `have` to go, Owen!
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to go, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Go `where?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Go [color=#e23b3b][i]where?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Off this island! Somewhere far away! Maybe in a few years she'll forget this ever happened!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A few years?! But... Us...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You should have thought of that beforehand! Now go!
Reluctantly, Owen leaves...
A few moments later, Paige realizes she might never see him again...
And that means...
Owen is halfway to the door!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I'm marrying Tad because we need him, Paige! I'm marrying Tad, because without him, we're broke!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Do you remember what it was like when your father and I split?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: We were so destitute, you had to shoplift in order to maintain the lifestyle you'd become so accustomed to!
Owen is almost out the door!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I remember...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I never want to go through that again, dear.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I never want to be in a situation where...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: ...Where I want to give you everything I can, but can afford to give you nothing...
As soon as Margot says this, Owen turns, the dress snagging on a dresser drawer!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Do you understand?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, I do. I just... I think you should be marrying Tad for the right reason.
Owen fiddles with the dress, trying to unhook it!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Get out, Owen! I can't keep her attention for much longer!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And what's the right reason, my wise, high school-aged daughter?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you love me?
Margot's attention snaps back to her daughter!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What? What did you ask me?
Over Margot's shoulder, Paige can see Owen breathe a silent sigh of relief. He starts tiptoeing out, the dress in his hand!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Almost there!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Do you love me?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: How could you ask such a thing?! Of course I love you!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then why are you marrying Tad?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Ow!
Reflexively, Margot reaches out and pinches Paige back!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What'd you pinch `me` for?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What'd you pinch [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] for?!

nodes.text: Over Margot's shoulder, Paige can see Owen looking at her angrily, his eyes saying, 'That was `way` too close.'
nodes.text_bbcode: Over Margot's shoulder, Paige can see Owen looking at her angrily, his eyes saying, 'That was [b]way[/b] too close.'

nodes.text: He starts tiptoeing out, the dress in his hand!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige! `Why` did you pinch me?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige! [color=#3b78e2][i]Why[/i][/color] did you pinch me?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm just, I'm angry, actually! I don't understand why you're marrying Tad!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Wait!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Wait?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean...
Paige pinches Margot!
She positions herself so that Margot sits with her back to the closet, the wedding dress hanging in plain sight!
A moment later, Owen peeks his head in, sees that it's clear, and tiptoes in!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Are you all right? Your health is no laughing matter!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, mother... I'm not all right at all! And it has nothing to do with my health!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And nothing to do with me being nervous for some speech!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What then?
Owen arrives at the closet.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's about the wedding itself.
He reaches in.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What about it's got you in such a dreadful state?
He grabs the dress, but as he pulls it out, it knocks ever so slightly against the closet door!
Margot's head starts to turn!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Are you feeling sick?
Margot closes the door, a mildly concerned look on her face.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I should have done something more drastic!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Let's keep this door open! I think there's something in the air making me--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: That's odd... It's not bothering me at all.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just the same, the open door would be more welcoming, don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: ...Sure.
Paige re-opens the door awkwardly and then heads for the bed...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, Mother! I'm feeling faint!
Paige puts a hand to her head, stumbles, and then collapses on the bed!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige!
Margot rushes to Paige's side, leaving the door wide open!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And the award for greatest actress ever goes to... Me!
After some deep, fabricated swooning, Paige sits up...
Paige hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've gotta do something to get her attention!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I've got my eyes on all of you!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Well, not you, Conrad. You obviously had no hand in these shenanigans.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Actually, since I have you here...
Tad throws his arm around Conrad and walks off with him.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Let's discuss your father's upcoming social affairs!
As soon as Tad is gone, Paige pulls Owen aside.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Okay... Were you up all night last night like me, coming up with ways to sabotage the wedding?!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: No, I was sleeping. Like a normal person.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. I guess we'll use `my` plan then. Come with me!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever. I guess we'll use [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] plan then. Come with me!

nodes.text: Paige yanks Owen away...
A moment later, they're standing outside Margot's room. Margot's inside, humming a song.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Shoot. I thought she was still downstairs...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, want to clue me in, you know, at all?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The only way we're going to stop this wedding is if we take away all the glamour!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You can't be this dumb! Think about it... Pretend you're my mother...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'll go ahead and `pretend` that's a normal request.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll go ahead and [color=#e23b3b][i]pretend[/i][/color] that's a normal request.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you're excited about the wedding because of the dress and the flower-covered altar...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And then you take those away, what are you left with?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just Tad, I guess. Oh... Gross.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Exactly. Maybe if we clear away all this wedding fog, she'll see the real Tad!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Look, Paige, I know you've gone into full wedding destroyer mode, but isn't there a better, slightly more mature way?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Like, I don't know, actually `talking` to your mom?
nodes.text_bbcode: Like, I don't know, actually [color=#e23b3b][i]talking[/i][/color] to your mom?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, how's that conversation going to go?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'I don't like Tad.'

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Gee gosh, honey, I'll stop the wedding then.'

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That wasn't quite what I pictured.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well, she won't listen to me. She knows I hate Tad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, you want to what? Ruin her wedding gown?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, and maybe not let her know ahead of time! Keep your voice down!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How are you going to ruin the dress with Margot in the room?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's where you come in.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't like where this is going...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll keep her attention away from the closet. You take the dress.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yep. My instincts were right. And what happens when she catches me in the act?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Just trust me, okay? I know my mother. I can keep her attention.
Paige shoves Owen around a nearby corner and knocks on Margot's door. It swings open!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Paige, dear, I know exactly why you're here...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: It's about that speech you couldn't give at the rehearsal dinner...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Tad told me you were nervous.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did he?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Anyway, come in, and we'll talk...
As Paige enters the room, she sees that Margot is about to close the door behind her!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: The wind?! Really?
Paige nods.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It does feel, uh, drafty in here.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Never mind the fact that wind rushing through this house and knocking over that teapot defies the laws of physics!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: And never mind the fact that this painting had hung on this wall unfettered by `years` of weather!
nodes.text_bbcode: And never mind the fact that this painting had hung on this wall unfettered by [color=#e23b3b][i]years[/i][/color] of weather!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What perplexes me is how such a wind could have occurred with these doors locked shut and these windows closed!
Tad points an accusatory finger at the shut doors and windows!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Isn't it possible that these were open last night?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I don't know... Were they?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I. Also. Don't. Know.
Tad steps away, anger coursing through him.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Psst. Good save...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We need to work on our excuses more.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: For sure...
Tad turns back to Paige, Owen, and Conrad.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Ghosts?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, I'm pretty sure Paige didn't mean, like, real, `actual` ghosts. I'm pretty sure she meant--
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, I'm pretty sure Paige didn't mean, like, real, [color=#e23b3b][i]actual[/i][/color] ghosts. I'm pretty sure she meant--

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Ghosts! Of course! It would make sense for the Montgomeries of old to express their anger!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It would?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: My family's always been jealous of my wealth! Which `I` earned! And which `they` hated me for!
nodes.text_bbcode: My family's always been jealous of my wealth! Which [color=#e23b3b][i]I[/i][/color] earned! And which [color=#e23b3b][i]they[/i][/color] hated me for!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: And no one was worse than my uncle... Always insistent that I marry a blonde!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: The only thing he criticized more than art was tea!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So he's, like, haunting you in your house?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: He must be!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Then this might be the best time to, you know, talk to him.
Owen nudges Paige.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't push it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let me have my fun.
Tad clears his throat, looking up at the ceiling.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Uncle Winnipeg! If you can hear me, I am marrying this brunette and that's that!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I think that did it.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Still...
He turns back to Paige, Owen, and Conrad.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Anyway...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I've got just the thing to cheer you up!
Conrad reaches into his pocket and pulls out a gold-plated credit card.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I was going to give this to you tomorrow as a wedding gift...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: But seeing how upset you are now, I'd feel like a cad hanging onto it.
He hands the card to her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is a gold V.I.P. card! They're supposed to be a myth!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I don't get it. It's just a credit card...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, well, to a nobody it's nothing, but to a somebody it's everything!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It gets me exclusive deals on... On `every` store! On `every` thing I could want! On life! Oh, thank you so much, Conrad!
nodes.text_bbcode: It gets me exclusive deals on... On [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] store! On [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] thing I could want! On life! Oh, thank you so much, Conrad!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Sure, it was--
Paige throws her arms around Conrad in a big hug. He blushes.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: --Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We should get going. In case anyone else shows up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, okay.
Conrad leaves...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We'll come up with a plan tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course! I'll see you bright and early!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever plan we come up with, I just know it's going to work!
As they head off to their respective rooms for the night, Owen sees the change in Paige's mood and can't help but feel sad.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nothing I could have done would have made her feel as happy as that card Conrad got her...
You are now playing as Paige...
The next morning, Margot, Tad, and the guests discover the aftermath of Paige's destruction...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Oh dear me! Tad, look at this mess!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I'm looking at it!
Teapot shards are everywhere! The fallen painting is lying askew against the wall, its glass frame broken!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: Heavens!

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: What a fright!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sure it's nothing...
Margot tries to calm the high society ladies down...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Did I tell you about my grandmother's wedding ring? It's the ring we'll be using in the wedding, and it was once worn by European royalty...
Meanwhile, Tad's accusing glare immediately lands on Paige, Owen, and Conrad.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Young people, you're always up late at night with your telephone screens and your naughty dance parties!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What century are you from?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Focus! Do you know anything about this?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Nope.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: No, sir.
Tad turns to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: And `you.` You wouldn't have anything to do with this, would you?
nodes.text_bbcode: And [color=#e23b3b][i]you.[/i][/color] You wouldn't have anything to do with this, would you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Me? No! This looks like it was caused by...

nodes.prompt: This looks like it was caused by...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: This looks like it was caused by...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Time? I don't understand.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh, well... Paige is just upset because she won't get to spend as much time with her mother now that she's marrying.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: And I've been trying to tell her that Margot will still be there for her when she needs her...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: `That's` what you're making this fuss over, Paige?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That's[/i][/color] what you're making this fuss over, Paige?

nodes.text: Owen shoots Paige an imploring look. She crosses her arms and sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. Yeah, I guess I am.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Good save, me!

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: That's nothing to be `so` upset over.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's nothing to be [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] upset over.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, it seems illogical to be this upset about that... But here I am, `illogically` mad!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, it seems illogical to be this upset about that... But here I am, [color=#3b78e2][i]illogically[/i][/color] mad!

nodes.text: Conrad crosses his arms.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: So you're telling me Paige flew into a blind rage because of... Mathematics?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Math does have that kind of effect on people.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It wasn't--

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's in denial.
Owen rubs Paige's shoulder robotically.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There, there, Paige, sweetie. You don't have to worry about sines and cosines anymore.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's, um, summertime.
Paige sighs.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, `dear.` I was really irritated by... isosceles triangles.
nodes.text_bbcode: Thanks, [color=#3b78e2][i]dear.[/i][/color] I was really irritated by... isosceles triangles.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cough. That's geometry!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Fine. Solving for X.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cough. Algebra!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Pathetic, you two. I `know` you're up to something. And frankly, I'm a dash hurt that you won't share it with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Pathetic, you two. I [color=#e23b3b][i]know[/i][/color] you're up to something. And frankly, I'm a dash hurt that you won't share it with me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sorry, Conrad...

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: I'll be the honorable one and assume it's for the best.

nodes.speaker: Conrad
nodes.text: Because... Of...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... Trigonometry?
The vase bounces right off his hands and shatters on the ground beside him!
Owen does nothing, staring wide-eyed as the vase falls onto him!
`WHOMP!`
It bounces off his head and shatters on the ground beside him!
Paige has failed.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen doesn't have `any` money...
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen doesn't have [color=#3b78e2][i]any[/i][/color] money...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: He doesn't?! Then what was all that kerfuffle yesterday about polo and clay pigeons?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was a lie to get you to like him... Back when I actually cared.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The truth is he's super poor. Like, his house is smaller than this room!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Glad we could establish that in front of such a large crowd.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: ...But whatever, he's happy!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, not `right now,` but in general, he is!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, not [color=#3b78e2][i]right now,[/i][/color] but in general, he is!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's right... I am pretty happy.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So don't do this, Mother. It's super dumb.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Well, I've heard enough! Your mother has already chosen me! We are having this wedding `now!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I've heard enough! Your mother has already chosen me! We are having this wedding [color=#e23b3b][i]now![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: And we are having it without you two! So... Get! Out!
Tad grabs at Paige, but she steps back, crossing her arms over her chest defiantly!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Make me!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Grr! I `will!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr! I [color=#e23b3b][i]will![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Tad snatches at Paige's arm again, catching her wrist tightly!
She pulls back, yanking her arm free! The motion causes her to lose her balance, and she falls hard!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ow!
In an instant, Owen rushes at Tad, his fist cocked!
But Margot steps in between them!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Wait! Don't!
Owen stops mid-punch, and Margot calls out to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, no thanks to Grandpa Grabby!
Paige stands, shaking her wrist off.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Get them out of here, Margot!
Margot turns to Tad.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: My daughter has gone to great lengths this weekend to try and keep us apart...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Unsuccessfully...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And she did that `knowing` it would cost us your fortune!
nodes.text_bbcode: And she did that [color=#3b78e2][i]knowing[/i][/color] it would cost us your fortune!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: But my Paige would give up vast sums of money `only` if she felt like you were...
nodes.text_bbcode: But my Paige would give up vast sums of money [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] if she felt like you were...

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: The slimiest, most disgusting, ill-bred, vile stain on humanity!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whoa! Go, Mom!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: What are you saying?!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: What I'm saying is... No one manhandles my daughter!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And in case that wasn't clear enough, `the wedding is off!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And in case that wasn't clear enough, [color=#3b78e2][i]the wedding is off![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: Grrrrrr! Then all of you, get out!
A few moments later, outside the estate...
Paige, Owen, and Margot are walking along the road, while Tad yells after Margot!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: We'll see how well you do without my riches, Margot!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I hope you're imagining life without massages! Life without spa days! Life without comfort!

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: No more servants! No more butlers! No more tea parties while wearing extravagant pearls! All of it, gone!
Margot whirls around!

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: And I hope you're prepared for a life of social obscurity! I believe those are `my` friends headed for the yachts right now.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I hope you're prepared for a life of social obscurity! I believe those are [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] friends headed for the yachts right now.

nodes.text: Tad turns around, dismayed to see a procession of high society members making their way toward the harbor.

nodes.speaker: Rich Lady
nodes.text: I'm `still` shaking. That scandal was so crudely... `Public.`
